readiness.label: OpenRouter Free
readiness.message: OpenRouter Free needs a OpenRouter API key: add one in Settings → API keys, or set VIBECODER_OPENROUTER_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment. An empty value counts as unset.

readiness.label: Custom Auto
readiness.message: Custom Auto needs a Custom Gateway API key: add one in Settings → API keys, or set VIBECODER_CUSTOM_API_KEY or CUSTOM_API_KEY or FREELLMAPI_API_KEY in the environment. An empty value counts as unset.

readiness.label: GPT-OSS 120B
readiness.message: GPT-OSS 120B needs a Groq API key: add one in Settings → API keys, or set VIBECODER_GROQ_API_KEY or GROQ_KEY or GROQ_API_KEY in the environment. An empty value counts as unset.

readiness.label: Cerebras Llama
readiness.message: Cerebras Llama needs a Cerebras API key: add one in Settings → API keys, or set VIBECODER_CEREBRAS_API_KEY or CEREBRAS_API_KEY in the environment. An empty value counts as unset.

readiness.label: GLM Flash
readiness.message: GLM Flash needs a Z.ai API key: add one in Settings → API keys, or set VIBECODER_ZAI_API_KEY or ZAI_API_KEY or Z_AI_API_KEY in the environment. An empty value counts as unset.

readiness.label: HF GPT-OSS
readiness.message: HF GPT-OSS needs a Hugging Face API key: add one in Settings → API keys, or set VIBECODER_HF_TOKEN or HF_TOKEN or HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY in the environment. An empty value counts as unset.

readiness.label: Nemotron (NVIDIA)
readiness.message: Nemotron (NVIDIA) needs a NVIDIA NIM API key: add one in Settings → API keys, or set VIBECODER_NVIDIA_API_KEY or NVIDIA_API_KEY or NVIDIA_NIM_API_KEY in the environment. An empty value counts as unset.

readiness.label: Gemini Flash
readiness.message: Gemini Flash needs a Google API key: add one in Settings → API keys, or set VIBECODER_GEMINI_API_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY or GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY in the environment. An empty value counts as unset.
